review.name: Platypus Walk (Rocky River)
review.reason: For: Wikivoyage names a platypus viewing walk of about an hour from the Flinders Chase visitor centre, a real wildlife activity. Against: single counted source, success depends on dawn/dusk luck, and it lies within Flinders Chase.

review.name: Pelican Lagoon
review.reason: For: board names the marine sanctuary for non-motorised paddling and sunrise/sunset. Against: single counted source, essentially the backdrop of American River town, which is a separate candidate.

review.name: Independence replica and Rebuild Independence Project
review.reason: Tourism board American River page names the Independence replica at the town turnoff and the shed on the wharf where volunteers rebuild the ship. For: named heritage stop. Against: small volunteer project, one source, ~20 min, shed opening unclear.

review.name: Clifford's Honey Farm
review.reason: For: Wikivoyage names it with a hive and film viewing and honey tasting, a long-standing roadside stop on the way to the south coast. Against: listed under Buy, mainly a shop; one counted source.

review.name: Emu Ridge Eucalyptus Distillery
review.reason: For: Wikivoyage and tourism both name it; shop with distillery and live wallaby/kangaroo. Against: essentially a shop and cafe.

review.name: Old Wisanger School
review.reason: For: tourism board lists the 1884 school as a heritage site visitors can walk through. Against: tiny, one source, access times not stated.

review.name: Penneshaw Lookout
review.reason: For: Wikivoyage lists it (24/7, free, rolling plains by the ocean). Against: a roadside lookout with a short stop, single source.

review.name: Kangaroo Island Shipwreck Trail
review.reason: Case for: agency (DEW) Shipwreck Trails page and the tourism board name a signed island-wide heritage trail with interpretive signs at wreck sites, free to visit. Case against: a dispersed set of roadside/shore signs (e.g. Kona wreck at Antechamber Bay), no single place to spend half an hour; individual sites are the places.

review.name: Western River Wilderness Protection Area
review.reason: For: the tourism board names a track in it to Billy Goat Falls (winter falls) and Western River Cove camp ground with a beach. Against: remote, single counted source, falls flow seasonally, and the real draws (Billy Goat Falls, Western River Cove) would be better spots than the protected-area label; no agency page found.

review.name: St Albans Church
review.reason: Tourism board page names the oldest public building in Kingscote (1884 chancel) and two stained-glass windows incl. one depicting island elements. For: named interior detail, heritage. Against: small local church, one source, ~15 min visit; no stated public opening.

review.name: The Cairn
review.reason: Tourism page: cairn marking the first Post Office site on Governor Wallen Drive, early settler remains and a walk up Flagstaff Hill with views over Backstairs Passage. For: a free walk with views and settlement heritage. Against: the cairn itself is a minor marker, one source, ~30 min.

review.name: Old Cemetery Kingscote
review.reason: Tourism page: South Australia's oldest cemetery, preserved, holding 1836 South Australia Company settlers. For: genuine heritage site, free and open. Against: single source, short visit, closer to a memorial/cemetery than an attraction.
